summary_1line: Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, begins instructing Yudhishthira on sacred places, emphasizing the supreme sanctity and sin-cleansing power of the river Ganga.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows surrounded by the Pandavas and many gathered rishis shining with ascetic radiance.
The celestial river Ganga descends from heaven and is caught in the matted hair of Shiva before flowing to the earth.
Pilgrims bathe at sunrise in the wide, shining waters of the Ganga as swans and waterfowl glide across the river.
